definitions.explanation: A personal or historical connection to a place, person, or thing. Often used to describe places associated with famous historical figures.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ゆかり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have a connection to this land.

examples.japanese: ゆかり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}する→紹介する：05641_shoukaisuru⟧。
examples.english: To introduce a person with connections.

examples.japanese: {源氏物語|げんじものがたり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ゆかり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巡|めぐ}る→巡る：03930_meguru⟧⟦ツアー→ツアー：08285_tsuaa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}した→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: I joined a tour visiting places associated with The Tale of Genji.

notes:
WRITING:
Can be written as {縁|ゆかり}, but hiragana is more common.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ゆかり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧ (a place with connections to)
- ゆかり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧ (a person with ties to)
- ゆかり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{地|ち} (a place of connection/association)

USAGE:
Frequently encountered in tourism and historical contexts, such as 「{織田信長|おだのぶなが}ゆかり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{地|ち}」 (places associated with Oda Nobunaga). Also used as a female given name.
